Players will be greeted with a bonus game mode after completing the game with The Pit, a roguelike challenge mode that sends waves of enemies and challenges to end the reign of Kratos and Deimos. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op in The Pit for God of War Sons of Sparta, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: God of War Sons of Sparta - Official 'The Pit' Co-op Mode Gameplay Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Resident Evil Requiem has finally arrived, ready to provide you with hours and hours of survival horror action, in which you can test your mettle as both Grace Ashcroft and Leon S. Kennedy. Much like its modern predecessors, Requiem boasts a reasonably stacked campaign, but just how long is it? Here, we’ll let you know exactly how many hours it took different members of the IGN team to finish the game, and what they prioritised doing with that time. How do the Modern, Classic, and Insanity difficulties compare? Let's find out!

#IGN #ResidentEvilRequiem #HowLongToBeat
title: How Long is Resident Evil Requiem?

author: IGN
description:
Wild Blue Skies is essentially a Star Fox game and they are not being shy about this. Everything from the aresenal at your disposal, the core gameplay, the characters on your team, the way the team communicates throughout the mission, the mission design, the missions briefings, and, you guessed it, the barrel roll, are all very much Star Fox with a different coat of paint. If you're less than patient with the absence of a new Star Fox game, Wild Blue Skies might just scratch the itch. Sure, you're not in the Lylat system fending off the forces of Andross, but it's very easy to imagine you are while playing this. Here's 7 Minutes of Wild Blue Skies gameplay.

#ign #gaming
title: A True Star Fox 64 Spiritual Successor - Wild Blue Skies Gameplay

author: IGN
description:
Check out gameplay from Resident Evil: Requiem captured directly from a docked Nintendo Switch 2. The Nintendo Switch 2 version of the game is an outstanding port that boasts an upscaled 4k resolution when docked thanks to Nvidias DLSS technology and a 1080p resolution while hand held. The game targets a smooth 60 FPS in both configurations. Whichever version you choose to play the game in, Leons custom Porsche Cayenne Turbo GT will look great.

00:00 - Grace Gameplay
15:32 - Leon Gameplay

Gameplay captured from a docked Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Resident Evil: Requiem - 22 Minutes of Grace & Leon Switch 2 Gameplay | 4K 60 FPS

author: IGN
description:
As the Switch 2 enters the latter half of its first year, it’s starting to get some pretty impressive ports and Resident Evil Requiem is no exception. In this video we’re going to compare the game running on a docked Switch 2 vs a PC with the settings cranked all the way up. 
The handheld version is surprisingly solid. While some textures and details don’t look as good as you would get from a much larger box, the game runs at a solid 60fps with very few dips and its environments and characters look outstanding on the Switch 2’s HDR screen. Leons Custom Porsche Cayenne Turbo GT looks great wherever you play. 

Gameplay Captured on a docked Nintendo Switch 2 and a PC with an RTX 4090 GPU

#IGN #Gaming #ResidentEvil
title: Resident Evil Requiem - Switch 2 Vs PC Graphics Comparison

author: IGN
description:
Resident Evil Requiem boasts the series’ hallmark resource management, high intensity shooting, and beautiful Leon one-liners. It also features a split campaign, where you play part of the story as Grace, an FBI analyst untested in the field, and rugged veteran Leon S. Kennedy. Fittingly, their playstyles are very different, and require different tips to avoid making mistakes with either of them. Here are the biggest mistakes to avoid in Resident Evil Requiem, first for Grace, and then for Leon.

Timecodes:
00:00 - Intro
01:01 - Grace - Try To Open Every Door
01:25 - Don’t Just Rush Through a Closed Door
01:45 - Safe Rooms Aren’t Always “Safe”
02:04 - You Don’t Need to Fight Every Zombie
03:03 - Know Where To Shoot When You Shoot
03:35 - Don’t Waste Your Requiem Bullets
04:04 - Don’t Leave Resources Behind
05:11 - Don’t Waste Your Bottles
05:20 - Don’t Engage Blister Heads Without A Plan
06:10 - Leon (SPOILER WARNING) - Don’t Neglect Your Hatchet
07:23 - Prioritize Weapon-Wielding Ene
title: Resident Evil Requiem: 12 Big Mistakes To Avoid
